extracted.name: Amaretto espresso martini
extracted.description: Add amaretto to a traditional espresso martini to create more depth. Perfect for coffee lovers, kick back and enjoy in classic martini glasses
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp sugar syrup or runny honey
instruction_lines: Put two martini glasses in the fridge to chill.
Pour all the ingredients into a cocktail shaker and shake until it feels icy cold in your hand. Strain into the chilled glasses to serve.
